title: The Enemies of Books
summary: "The Enemies of Books" by William Blades is a historical account written in the late 19th century. Blades argues that such losses to humanity's literary treasures are incalculable. He illustrates how these calamities have not only affected written works but also shaped our understanding of cultural heritage.
